Nov 13 weekend ingest added EstateSales.net, Craigslist, Facebook and Nextdoor sales for Nov 13–15 (plus the Nov 21 Stablewood HOA rummage sale). Overlay also corrects Forest Crest dates to Nov 13–14, moves the Southern Hills community pin from downtown to Southern Bluff in 78222, places the Braunridge community sale at 9803 Rostock Ln (starts 6 AM), and replaces the Buckskin Dr ZIP-centroid with a Census geocode. Crystal Knoll hours updated to 8 AM–3 PM from the Nextdoor event. Shavano Glenn ZIP 78230 filled from Census. Socoma HOA (Stone Oak, no street) was skipped; Alamo Ranch estate sale in 78253 was skipped until the address posts Nov 19. Nov 19 evening email ingest added 1 FormSubmit neighbor tip: garage sale at 9814 Valley Villa, San Antonio, TX 78250 (Hidden Meadow), Sat Nov 21–Mon Nov 23 (no hours given on the form). Nov 25 morning email ingest added 1 GarageSaleFinder sale already listed in the Austin city file but missing from the live 60-mile San Antonio map: 251 Summer Dr, Kyle, TX 78640 (Four Seasons Farm), Sat Nov 28, 8:00 AM–11:00 AM, Census-geocoded at 53.8 miles from downtown.
